title: When the Wardrobe Sings
author: Marguerite Eriksen
blurb: Xanthe Halloran, a restaurant critic who has forgotten how food tastes, has spent twelve years practicing the art of almost saying it. Then a childhood home goes up for auction — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. Now they must translate the untranslatable sentence and live with it, and time is already running out.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
